en.html:
As the manner required, I brought the enemy back into the monitor.
Naturally. This was the opponent who had left Captain Ootori's life or death in doubt. To such a one, I was to turn my back?

Until that supremely disagreeable shape was knocked from the sky, the sword was not going back into its sheath.
With the anger still smoldering, I advanced.

作法に則り、敵影を<ruby>視界<rt>モニター</rt></ruby>へ戻す。
　当然だ……大鳥大尉の生死を定かならぬものとして
くれた相手に、どうして背中を向けられるか！

　あの不快極まる姿を叩き落とすまで、太刀は納めら
れない。
　俺は燻り続ける怒りと共に、進撃した。
